name.ja: HG 1/72 ブレイディハウンド(ブラッド専用機)

description.ja: 2021年10月より放送開始の『境界戦機』より、ブレイディハウンド部隊を束ねる北米同盟軍の指揮官機が商品化！ストークキャリーや量産機と部隊編成が可能。
description.en: From "Kyoukai Senki", which will start broadcasting from 202110, the commander aircraft of the North American Alliance Force, which controls the Brady Hound troops, has been commercialized! It is possible to form units with stalk carry and mass-produced aircraft.

description.ja: ■ソードが２本付属、ライフルのマガジンとグレネードは着脱可能。
description.en: • Two swords are included, and the rifle magazine and grenade are removable.

description.ja: ■ハンドパーツは２種付属し、武器持ち手は手甲パーツをスライドしナックルモードを再現。
description.en: • Two types of hand parts are included, and the weapon holder can be recreated in knuckle mode by sliding the gauntlet part.

description.ja: ■駐機状態用の頭部パーツも付属し、差し替えで再現可能。
description.en: • A head part for the parked state is also included and can be reproduced by replacing it.
• The claws on the legs can be stored.

description.ja: ■「肩」「頭部」「ソード」を含むブラッド専用機の特徴的な形状を再現。
description.en: • Reproduces the characteristic shape of Blood's special machine, including the "shoulders ", " head " and " sword".

description.ja: ■「HG 1/72 V-33 ストークキャリー」(別売り)と組み合わせて輸送状態を再現。
description.en: • Reproduce the transportation condition in combination with "HG 1/72 V-33 Stalk Carry" (sold separately).

accessories.ja: ハンドパーツ 武器持ち手(左右)、 平手(左右)
accessories.en: Hand parts Weapon handle (left and right), open hand (left and right)

accessories.ja: 専用ライフル(グレネードランチャー装備)×1
accessories.en: Special rifle (equipped with grenade launcher) x 1
